name: Robbery
description: Risk it all to steal from other players

commands.name: rob
commands.description: Attempt to steal coins from another player's wallet
commands.longDescription: Try to steal coins from another player's wallet. Success steals 10-30% of their wallet, but failure costs you 100 coins. Padlocks can block robbery attempts.

options.name: target
options.description: The player to attempt to rob

examples.output: 🏈 Interception! You picked off 🪙 450 from Nixon's wallet!
🚫 Nixon's padlock stopped you! The padlock was consumed.
💀 Fumble! You were caught and fined 🪙 100

tips: Steal 10-30% of target's wallet on success
Target must have at least 100 coins in wallet
Victims have 60-minute protection after being robbed
